reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.body:
Been with Lebara for about 2.5 years since 3 turned off the 3G signal (which means my US handset was no longer able to make calls as it's not authorized in the UK for VoLTE). I literally pay nothing per month (was £1.10 for 9 months, now £3.50 per month) for 35GB and cannot fault them. 

Customer service on the occasions I've needed them have been fab and answer the phone very quickly, signal is fine (and I have a US handset so not all UK/Vodafone 4G and 5G bands are supported - and my calls have to go over 2G). 

Really couldn't recommend them enough!

reviews.title: Refurbished phone sold as new
reviews.body:
Lebara sold me a UAE refurbished phone saying its new. Only got to know when I visited Samsung. Phone was manufactured in the UAE, started working on the 16th of Jan 26 and I bought it on the 12th of Aug 26.Now it's  giving me problems, they are hiding behind technicalities. 
"Send original packaging and accessories or else you pay for them or we won't replace the phone.
We have to assess the phone and then decide"
You are defrauding unsuspecting clients selling refurbished phones as new, non UK phones which you know do not carry any warranty with Samsung UK.
Stop the fraud and misrepresentation. 
Stop selling refurbished phones as new.
